label: Connection
description: An approved relationship between this Myme tenant and an external authority. `kind` discriminates between variants: `user-app-grant` (an OAuth client this user has authorised — workstream 1), `external-service-connector` (a hosted/local connector that reads or writes Myme on the user's behalf — workstream 2), and `tenant-share` (cross-tenant access — future). Lifecycle bounded to active | revoked. Has no tier. The connector kind also carries a `runtime_status` distinct from the lifecycle `status`; runtime_status is server-stamped only (no client write path in WS2 — runtime executor lands in WS3).

last_used_at.description: Most recent successful use of any token issued under this grant

revoked_at.description: When the grant was revoked, if any

integration_ref.description: For kind: external-service-connector — id of the Integration manifest this connector implements

credential_ref.description: For kind: external-service-connector — id of a system.credential item holding the connector's API key

configuration.description: For kind: external-service-connector — per-Integration JSON config payload (shape determined by the Integration manifest)

direction.description: For kind: external-service-connector — does this connector read from, write to, or both

triggers.description: For kind: external-service-connector — array of trigger declarations. Each entry shape: { type: 'schedule' | 'webhook' | 'item-event' | 'manual', ...per-type config }. The Integration manifest constrains which trigger types are valid.

attached_device.description: For kind: external-service-connector — id of a system.device item; set when the connector runs on a specific local device (e.g. a sync-agent host)

runtime_status.description: For kind: external-service-connector — operational health, distinct from the universal lifecycle `status`. Server-stamped only in WS2 (no client write surface; runtime executor in WS3 is the legitimate writer).

last_sync_at.description: For kind: external-service-connector — last successful sync run timestamp

next_run_at.description: For kind: external-service-connector — next scheduled run, when applicable

last_error_at.description: For kind: external-service-connector — most recent failure timestamp (cleared on next success)

feed_activity.description: For kind: external-service-connector — when true, system.activity items emitted by this connector are server-stamped tier:'feed' (otherwise tier is omitted, as for all other system.* writes)
